briefTitle: Safety Study for a Gamma Delta T Cell Product Used With Low Dose Radiotherapy in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC or Solid Tumors With Bone Metastases

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum body weight of 50 kilograms (kg).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Body weight is not one of the allowed typed criteria kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC or locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with bone metastasis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic descriptions are in scope but do not provide a structured stage list for stage_in.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Genomic screening, with tumors with known actionable molecular alterations, such as EGFR, ALK, ROS-1, BRAF, RET, MET, and KRAS etc., must have progressed on appropriate target-directed molecular therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Lists multiple broad actionable alterations and prior target-directed therapies without a single biomarker cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable target lesion based on RECIST v1.1 confirmed by radiological imaging. Participants with isolated bone metastases are eligible for enrollment are not required to have measurable disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematopoietic, hepatic and renal function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function without specific numeric lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Chemotherapy, investigational, and/or check-point inhibitor therapy within the 30 days prior to study Day 1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for prior systemic therapies is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery, except for vascular access placement, within the 30 days prior to study Day 1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Major surgery washout is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active autoimmune disease requiring immunosuppressive therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active autoimmune disease is a clinical judgment-based exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Infection requiring systemic treatment within 30 days prior to study Day 1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Recent infection requirement is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of peritoneal effusion (ascites), pericardial, or pleural effusions/nodules.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of effusions is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled hypertension, history of arrhythmia including atrial fibrillation, unstable angina, decompensated congestive heart failure, cardiac ejection fraction ≤ 50%, myocardial infarction, or marked baseline prolonged QT/QTc intervals.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex cardiovascular exclusions contain multiple conditions and an LVEF threshold not matching allowed cardiac typed items.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), Hepatitis B, or Hepatitis C detection.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Viral serology exclusions are not covered by allowed typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participation in the treatment portion of a clinical trial or completed a clinical trial within the 30 days prior to the first dose of KB-GDT-01.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior trial participation washout is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of any condition that may, in the opinion of the Investigator, render the patient inappropriate from participating in the study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion is a subjective judgment-based item.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Live vaccines administered within 30 days prior to study Day 1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Live vaccine washout is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Superior vena cava obstruction
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Superior vena cava obstruction is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior radiation therapy to a selected LDRT treatment site </= 30 days prior to Day 1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior radiation washout window is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum body weight of 50 kilograms (kg).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Body weight is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC or locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with bone metastasis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope but does not list specific numerical stages for a stage_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Progressed on SOC therapy including platinum-based chemotherapy and immune checkpoint inhibitors (NSCLC), and are not a candidate for further standard anti-neoplastic therapy and/or have exhibited intolerance to and/or declined clinically applicable salvage therapies, and/or have declined therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex prior line and standard of care requirements that cannot be expressed as a single typed prior_therapy_required or prior_lines check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Genomic screening, with tumors with known actionable molecular alterations, such as EGFR, ALK, ROS-1, BRAF, RET, MET, and KRAS etc., must have progressed on appropriate target-directed molecular therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multiple varied potential biomarkers are mentioned as examples rather than a single explicit required gene presence check.
